solution_summary: VideoAmp uses Snowflake on Snowflake to replace slow, expensive media measurement data infrastructure so engineers and modelers could unify large household datasets and iterate on ml faster. Large audience and media datasets from tens of millions of households and devices are consolidated on Snowflake for measurement and modeling. VideoAmp uses the shared platform to backfill, transform, and analyze those datasets much faster than on its prior stack, which had become expensive and slow. Engineers and data teams work from the same environment to improve ML workflows, media measurement products, and downstream analytics used across the business. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
